animationSupplement.observation: Blank opening hold, then yellow-hoodie character enters from left, jumps, lands and exits right; no added text. First two encoded frames are identical.
Brown-haired hat character retains 周一不想上班 caption; tired standing, yawning, sitting/crying and recovery poses are distinct. Caption persists.
Golden Gate bridge and coastal composition retained; wave positions, gulls and visitors vary. Landscape redraw drift remains; not a locked painted layer.
Colosseum remains recognizable; cyclist, scooter, pedestrians and birds change positions. Visible position reset between final and first frame; architecture varies slightly.
Pagoda and Fuji remain recognizable; petals and visitors change position with slight landscape/building drift.
Gray corridor starts empty, humanoid appears and approaches; later views tilt and crop the approaching figure. Final view is tilted corridor, not a seamless return.
Blue-top/yellow-cardigan subject, water gun and garden persist across shot changes; water splashes and changing close-up/full-body framing form a montage.
Bearded dwarf with axe turns from front through back and sides; fur, straps and axe vary slightly between drawn views.
Sword embedded in stone is shown from successive viewpoints, with blue grip, gold guard, moss and glowing rune. Not geometrically exact 3D rotation.
Dark futuristic motorbike with blue highlights appears front, side, back and three-quarter; wheels and body details shift across views.
Seated tabby rotates through front, side and back views on a gray background; fur and body proportions vary slightly.
Blue-haired whale-maid character holds rice bowl, lifts spoon, closes eyes and smiles; 真香! caption and costume remain visible.
Blue-haired whale-maid alternates tired/cheerful poses, raises hands and waves; 下班! caption remains. Minor redraw variation persists.
Green-uniform basketball character crouches, jumps, dunks at hoop, descends and lands; final held-ball pose resets the sequence.
Seated Tibetan fox maintains deadpan face and 好棒棒 caption while front paws rise, meet and lower; body scale changes slightly.
Red-scarf penguin smiles, raises wings, jumps and lands. First two encoded frames hold the same pose; outline shifts slightly.
Red-scarf penguin develops angry brows and red face marks, stomps/lifts alternating feet and flaps wings; final pose remains angry rather than neutral.
Penguin lowers head, forms a tear, wipes it with wing, then returns to neutral. First two frames hold the same pose.
Smiling red-scarf penguin dances side to side with alternating raised wings and feet; small redraw changes remain.
Original blue/green-clothed swordsman draws and sweeps sword with a water arc, then recovers. Water reaches near frame edges; final/first stance changes.
Brown-haired anime face with green eyes closes and reopens lids; clothing and framing remain consistent with slight redraw changes.
Cat looks ahead, winks, then green hat descends and settles. Robin lettering is legible on the hat. Final pose holds; this asset is configured for one playback.
Orange-haired chibi in blue overalls steps, raises arms, jumps and returns; full body fits every cell, with scale/ground-line variations.
Blue-robed wizard turns staff through distinct orientations and sparks appear near its tip; character and staff remain within cells.
Pixel-art Johnny Bravo alternates steps, arm pumps, hip shifts and a crouch; full character remains visible, no text or audio is represented.
Brown-haired anime character raises head, nods down and finishes with closed eyes. One middle frame uses drawn blur; final closed-eye hold differs from initial state.
